title: Latest Advances in 3D Characterization of Ore Particles for Mineral Processing by High Resolution X-ray Computed Tomography
content: Compared to the conventional methods to determine permeability, X-ray Computed Tomography (XCT) has been used to characterize the pore network in leach columns in 3D and estimate the permeability based on flow simulation using the Lattice Boltzmann Method (LBM) [1,2]. With the implementation of flat panel type detector, the leach column can be imaged at the voxel size below 100 μm, which would expose more information of the pore network inside packed particle bed.
